description.en: Editorial technical reading links, not verified citations or inheritance. Stored separately from computed map-similarity edges.
description.zh: 人工标注的技术阅读关联，不表示已核实引用或继承；与地图相似度连线分开保存。

reason.en: Model scaling and the data/training infrastructure needed to support it.
reason.zh: 模型规模研究及支撑其数据与训练规模的基础设施。

reason.en: World-action policies within a layered physical-agent workflow.
reason.zh: 世界动作策略在分层物理智能体工作流中的应用。

reason.en: Recovery and deployment data for continuous tasks and complete workflows.
reason.zh: 持续任务与完整工作流中的错误恢复和部署数据利用。

reason.en: Video-based world-action learning and transfer across robot embodiments, with different inference paths.
reason.zh: 视频世界动作学习与跨机器人本体迁移，推理路径并不相同。

reason.en: Video prediction as a training objective without requiring future-video generation in every policy mode.
reason.zh: 以视频预测辅助训练，而非要求所有策略模式在线生成未来视频。

reason.en: Scaling multimodal world-action learning using human and robot data.
reason.zh: 利用人类与机器人数据扩展多模态世界动作学习。

reason.en: A model case and a broader taxonomy of world-action modeling and execution.
reason.zh: 具体模型案例与世界动作建模及执行的领域分类。

reason.en: Multi-rate execution across separate reasoning or world-planning and action/control components.
reason.zh: 不同频率的推理或世界规划与动作控制模块协同执行。

reason.en: High-level task selection and memory coordinated with a low-level robot policy.
reason.zh: 高层任务选择与记忆同底层机器人策略协同。

reason.en: Data ingestion, preparation and delivery as bottlenecks in distributed training.
reason.zh: 分布式训练中的数据摄取、准备与交付瓶颈。

reason.en: Joint action-policy and world-prediction learning, using different discrete-token and diffusion formulations.
reason.zh: 联合动作策略与世界预测学习，分别采用离散 token 与扩散形式。

reason.en: Multi-expert world-action architectures and complementary video/action generation modes.
reason.zh: 多专家世界动作架构及互补的视频和动作生成模式。

reason.en: Mixture-of-Transformers video/action modeling for robot control.
reason.zh: 用于机器人控制的 Mixture-of-Transformers 视频动作建模。

reason.en: Cross-embodiment world-action policies and efficient online execution.
reason.zh: 跨本体世界动作策略与高效在线执行。

reason.en: World prediction and action-candidate evaluation for model-based planning.
reason.zh: 以世界预测与候选动作评估支持基于模型的规划。

reason.en: Interfaces between diffusion-based visual dynamics and robot action prediction.
reason.zh: 扩散视觉动态与机器人动作预测之间的接口。

reason.en: Temporal alignment between observations, slow world inference and asynchronous action execution.
reason.zh: 观测、低频世界推理与异步动作执行之间的时间对齐。

reason.en: Contrasting retained future conditioning with action-only inference after video co-training.
reason.zh: 比较保留未来条件与视频联合训练后仅推理动作的路线。

reason.en: Reusing world/action computation within denoising or across replanning cycles.
reason.zh: 在去噪内部或跨重规划周期复用世界动作计算。

reason.en: Observation-to-action latency and state alignment in real-time world-action execution.
reason.zh: 实时世界动作执行中的观测到动作延迟与状态对齐。

reason.en: Distinct OpenWAM projects comparing modular world/action coupling designs; these are separate publications.
reason.zh: 两项独立的 OpenWAM 工作均比较模块化世界动作耦合设计，属于不同论文。

reason.en: World/action expert coupling, joint denoising and human/robot pretraining.
reason.zh: 世界动作专家耦合、联合去噪及人类机器人预训练。
